# Overview

This is a broad, practical, introduction to R Programming. Here is a detailed [Syllabus](syllabus.html).

Perhaps the most important immediate need is to download and install R and Rstudio:

- To download R visit: http://www.r-project.org/  
- To download R Studio visit: https://posit.co/products/open-source/rstudio/?sid=1
